tweets.text:
With summer in full swing, the FBI’s commitment to protecting our communities remains unwavering. Through Operation Summer Heat, agents and analysts across the country continue to focus on the offenders who pose the greatest risks to public safety. Since June 1, our efforts have led to 2,560 arrests and 1,980 drug seizures, including 350 kg of fentanyl and 3,230 kg of cocaine.

Out of @FBICleveland our teams worked alongside partner agencies to execute a coordinated takedown of the 627 Gang, resulting in the arrest of 10 subjects and seizure of over 2 dozen firearms. On the other side of the nation, @FBISanFrancisco worked alongside ATF, USMS, DEA, and the Oakland Police Department to target offenders who possessed firearms. This effort resulted in 50 federal indictments and 76 firearms taken off the street.
 
As a whole, your #FBI will continue to deliver results with your safety in mind. Our communities are at the center of our mission.
